data.long_meaning: The name Bishan is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Vishnu’, meaning 'abode of all'. It is a name bestowed upon those who are believed to be blessed and fortunate. This name carries the blessings of Lord Vishnu, who is the preserver of the universe and the embodiment of love, compassion, and wisdom. The name Bishan carries the meaning “Blessed, Fortunate” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Bishan usually hope their child will grow to embody blessed, fortunate and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Embodiment of blessings and fortune from Lord Vishnu
